snippet.title: [Game Release Trailer] Witch You Want - Cute Fantasy Yuri Visual Novel
snippet.description:
Our cute magical yuri game, Witch You Want, is now released for free on Steam! Create your own witch apprentice and help a failgirl witch save her potion shop. It has character customization, Steam achievements, and multiple endings with 1 love interest.

Play it on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4253760/Witch_You_Want/

Follow us on Bsky: https://bsky.app/profile/vnstudioelan.com
